report.clinical_summary: Patient living with HIV for some time presents with new-onset fatigue (2 weeks) affecting concentration, ability to get out of bed, and simple tasks like cooking and walking with partner. Reports feeling 'quite depressed about everything' and 'wear[ed] down.' Adherence to Triumeq has been inconsistent - takes drug holidays when feeling well due to concerns about side effects, though more consistent after being advised. Has basic understanding of HIV but major gaps in understanding how it affects different body parts and why symptoms occur. Worries about future complications and long-term effects of medications. Describes sense of control as 'a constant balancing act' - sometimes feels in charge, other times feels illness is outside control.
